name: Asset browser, thumbnails and 3D previews
body:
# Asset browser

A panel (tab beside the outliner) that lists the palette's templates, the game's models (`assets/models/*.glb`) and
textures (`assets/textures/*.png`) as thumbnails, with a 3D preview of the selected one that can be orbited. Templates
can be added by double-click or dragged into the viewport. The thumbnails and the preview come from the Rust backend.
